title: Outstanding PoE Injector for Long Runs
review_text:
I have been working with security camera products for over 20 years - over that time I have installed systems for businesses, corporations and individuals - from enormous multimillion dollar systems to single camera nursery monitors. I’ve consulted on large projects and written about security vulnerabilities within networks for trade publications.

This is a field I know well. Over the years the technology has improved and become less and less expensive to produce. It is now practical to install security systems that would have only previously been used in commercial settings in residential.

Like most people who understand security cameras and their vulnerabilities I completely avoid WiFi cameras on most installations. While they are much easier to set up they are also far more vulnerable to hacking and security breaches.

Most of the systems I build and setup utilize Blue Iris, PoE switches and cameras. While initially this may seem more complicated, in the end it really isn’t and the system is far more stable and customizable.

PoE injectors, such as this one by AD-Net, are the perfect solution for when a camera needs to be placed at a farther distance from your central hub.

I set this up a bit over 3 months ago to power a camera located approximately 750’ from where this box is plugged in. I make my own Ethernet cables for these types of runs using trueCABLE Cat6 Direct Burial ( https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07VPGDBKW/ref=cm_sw_em_r_mt_dp_veE6FbZ3QK01F ) and pass through modular plugs ( https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0839DMK75/ref=cm_sw_em_r_mt_dp_5yE6FbX7NDWNX ). I utilized the same wire to run between the master and slave and had excellent results. This is where primary loss will occur and thus is critical to use the highest quality wires if using this over a large distance.

Something that is important to understand when running PoE systems is “line loss” - this refers to the power lost along the run of cable. The longer the cable the more loss there will be. While this device is capable of delivering 16W it can not deliver that over a 800 meter (.49 mile) run. It is important to review the chart pictured in the listing to understand the drop in power and speed over distance.

I ran this to a fairly power hungry PTZ camera that constantly scans the area. As I mentioned I have tested this device for a bit over 3 months and it has performed without any issue. Even though this is powering a large PTZ varifocal camera, from well over 700’ away, that is constantly scanning I have never experienced any drop in power that caused it to pause or drag. While I wouldn’t describe this device as plug and play installation was not difficult. I have been thoroughly impressed by this PoE injector and highly recommended it.

Why do I wait a few months to write my review? I have found many products perform perfectly when first received, but within a couple of months they begin to glitch and have issues. Like most consumers, I find this incredibly frustrating as then it is typically beyond the return window and I’m left with another useless broken device. During my testing I really push the limits of each device, I have them run 24/7 and maximize their capabilities in order to discover if there are any inherent flaws. While this process is time consuming, I have found it is the best way to determine what products are utilizing inferior components and what products really are worth purchasing as they will hold up and perform as expected for the long term.

The connector bases are reinforced at each end of the wire which really help hold all of the wires in place even if you have to bend and twist it to fit it within the plug.

One area where this cable could use improvement is the plug hood lacks a protective rubber boot guard that protects the clip on the plug - this becomes very important when snaking the cable through walls and tight spaces. Due to not having this feature it is critical to wrap the boot and plug with a small piece of electrical tape to make sure not to unintentionally snag anything as the cable is being snaked.

I love the grey PVC shielding on this cable - not only is it waterproof, durable and will help the cable withstand damage but it can be run along a wall and then painted to match the wall color.

I used this 65 foot cable to run between a PoE switch and an external security camera, this cable supplies power and transmits data to and from that security cameras - after thoroughly testing this cable over the last 3 months I’ve been nothing but impressed by this product.

This has proven to be an outstanding, dependable Ethernet Cable - this is really a top of the line cable that you’ll love.

This is a purchase that you’ll never regret. I’ve been utilizing two ZOSI cables for a3 months now and I’ve had nothing but outstanding results from them.

This is definitely a brand and product I recommend.

title: Excellent iPad Floor Stand but...
review_text:
During the last year I designed a workstation where my desktop computer sits next to my recliner and I have a 32” curved monitor that swivels over to face me. My keyboard and mouse tray swivels to rest in front of me when needed then out of my way when I’m finished. I was looking for a floor stand that would support my iPad Pro where I could pull it to me when needed and then move it out of the way when I didn’t - based on the listing I thought this would be the perfect product.

While the design of this product is very good, clearly the manufacturer did not test it with the iPad Pro even though it is specifically marketed for it. The springs simply are not strong enough to support the weight of the Pro. It will work fine for iPhones or smaller tablets but if you intend on using this for an iPad Pro you will want to replace at least one of the manufacturer’s springs with a 7/16” x 1-1/2” extension spring. Here is what I used - https://www.amazon.com/dp/B008RFNRIW/ref=cm_sw_em_r_mt_dp_Pq.TFbC339YC7

After replacing the spring I had no further issues and the floor stand operates as it should. This would be an easy correction for the manufacturer to make but currently as it is delivered I would not recommend this item for users of the iPad Pro. While the fix is not difficult, when purchasing a product marketed specifically for that unit we should not have to modify the product in any way.

If the correct springs were included this would be a solid 5 star item, as it is I give it a 3 and advise ordering the spring when purchasing the stand if you want to use this with your Pro.

title: Great Window Alarms - App Could be Better
review_text:
I have been using these window alarms for a few months and have found them fairly dependable. These products will not replace a traditional security system but instead are a nice addition to a more advanced security system.

As with any similar product it’s important to have a strong WiFi signal in the location they are placed so they can communicate. I utilize an excellent mesh network so this has not been an issue.

These will send an alert through the app when they detect vibration and the alarm will go off for around 20 seconds. It’s loud and will scare off the majority of intruders.

The sensitivity can not be controlled via the app but only on the sensor itself and the alarm can not be stopped within the app - this makes them less than smart other than their ability to send an alert to your phone. Receiving an alert is important especially when away from home. I use these in conjunction with my security cameras so if one was to go off I can quickly pull up the camera for that area and check activity.

If the app was improved allowing for setting sensitivity and alarm cancellation this would definitely be a 5 star product - even as it is, this is a reasonable product at a decent price.

This is an easy way to add another layer of security to your property without spending too much money. When used in combination with a more advanced security system these are a great addition.

title: Major Safety Concerns
review_text:

If you do a bit of research into these extenders - there are MANY that use identical internal components and non updatable firmware, all of which are incredibly insecure. By using these you will put your entire network at jeopardy.

While there are ways to flash these it is far more complex than it’s worth to utilize the cheap components within.

This is a product I would never recommend.

title: Outstanding Flat Cat6 Cable
review_text:
I have used and tested more Ethernet cables than I can remember and there is no question, all Ethernet cables are not created equally. Every one of the AmazonBasics branded items I’ve tested has been excellent and this cable is no exception.

Typically any device requiring an Ethernet cable will come with one in the packaging - it will work (usually). A good comparison is those cables are much like an old car - it should get you there, whereas this cable is like a high end sports car - it will get you there lightning fast, without fail.

This Cat6 is designed to be thin, but don’t let that fool you into thinking that it lacks capacity - within the thin PVC package contains aluminum shielding and 100% bare copper wires for super fast transfer speeds. The connector bases are reinforced at each end of the wire which really help hold all of the wires in place even if you have to bend and twist it to fit it within the plug. The plugs have a protective rubber boot guard that protects the clip on the plug - this becomes very important when snaking the cable through walls and tight spaces. Prior to doing this I wrap the boot and plug with a small piece of electrical tape to make sure I don’t unintentionally snag anything.

I love the white PVC shielding on this cable - not only is it durable and will help the cable withstand damage but it can be run along a wall and then painted to match the wall color.

I used this 100 foot cable to run between my router to a PoE switch that branches to several power and transmit data to and from one zone of my security cameras - a primary connection where speed and a reliable relay is critical - and I’ve been nothing but impressed by this product.

This has proven to be an outstanding, dependable Ethernet Cable - this is really a top of the line cable that you’ll love.

This is a purchase that you’ll never regret. I’ve been utilizing several ODOM cables for a while now and I’ve had noting but outstanding results from them. This is definitely a brand I recommend.

title: Excellent Quality Camera at a GREAT Price
review_text:
I have been working with security camera products for over 20 years - over that time I have installed systems for businesses, corporations and individuals - from enormous multimillion dollar systems to single camera nursery monitors. I’ve consulted on large projects and written about security vulnerabilities within networks for trade publications.

This is a field I know well. Over the years the technology has improved and become less and less expensive to produce. It is now practical to install security systems that would have only previously been used in commercial settings in residential.

If you are new to home security camera systems, I recommend going with wired (non-WiFi), NVR or computer based recorders run with systems such as Blue Iris. This type of system is infinitely more secure and stable. While initial setup costs are a bit more the security it affords is worth every penny. It always pays to research the products, discuss them with those in the field, understand vulnerabilities and PLAN YOUR SYSTEM PRIOR TO PURCHASING ANYTHING. If you are at all tech savvy at all you can do it. While there is a bit of a learning curve it is not awful and in the end you will be thankful for the time you spent in the beginning as it will save you time, money and endless frustration.

I have set up, tested and reviewed more security systems and individual products than I can possibly remember. Without question my go to solution for home security solutions is a computer based, Blue Iris system with PoE cameras run off of quality PoE switches. This type of system is not only easy to operate but is highly secure.

While this camera is not natively a PoE camera I’m happy to share the 5 Pairs Passive PoE Injector and PoE Splitter Kit with 5.5x2.1 mm DC Connector RJ45 Power Over Ethernet by Exgoofit ( https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07F82YK6P/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1 ) allow for this camera to operate almost identical to a PoE camera. The power adapter must be plugged in where the Ethernet cable is plugged in with the first pigtail adapter while the second adapter plugs onto the cameras power port and Ethernet jack. By utilizing this you can avoid the security concerns associated with WiFi cameras and still only have minimal wires run to the camera.

As with any component there are a host of factors to consider. In terms of cameras more megapixels is not always better. For instance 2MP cameras often perform better in low light while 5MP will allow for more detail when lighting is good. One disadvantage of higher megapixel cameras is the recordings will take up more hard drive space. Depending on the number of cameras, this can become a larger concern.

Highlights of this camera include:

Awesome Pan Tilt Zoom - Utilizing a 110° wide-angle lens and the head rotating 330° horizontally and 90° vertically, a 360° view is easily obtained. This makes this camera an outstanding choice to be placed on a corner of an eave where it can constantly monitor the largest possible area.

Jide Tech lens 5MP - in my tests over the last couple of months I have been impressed with the performance of this lens coupled with the CMOS image sensor SONY IMX335 and the HiS3516 chipset. Obviously this will not allow for the zoom capabilities of a varifocal lens but in comparison to many other cameras in the marketplace the performance of this camera is very good.

Low Light Capability - Images are excellent at even low light, far better than most similar cameras in this price range. IR lighting is dependable and nighttime / low light images are better than expected. My tests showed accurate images within 25’ of the IR lighting.

ONVIF compatibility - critical for using with software such as Blue Iris. Interestingly, I noticed another reviewer mentioned this camera did not work with Blue Iris, that was absolutely not my experience. I have only used it with Blue Iris and it has worked flawlessly. I have set it up with advanced features such as Watchdog and utilized multiple detection zones.

2 Way Audio - I have had no issues utilizing the 2 way audio through Blue Iris - sound is accurate, clear and minimal lag.

Great build quality - this camera is well built and will hold up outside in all conditions

I’d like to thank Joanna who works support at YoLuke who did her best to always provide the highest level of customer service as I researched this camera and worked on this review. Knowing there is a quality customer service team behind the scenes of security camera products is always important and in my experience, I feel that has been the case.

Over the course of my testing this product for a couple of months I’ve been thoroughly impressed. It loads into Blue Iris without any issue and advanced features work without any problems. By using the PoE splitter kit I referenced above you can easily make this a secure camera by avoiding the use of WiFi. Build quality is excellent - this is made to last and hold up even in severe conditions.

This is a product I would definitely recommend. While this is the first YoLuke camera I have reviewed I look forward to seeing other cameras they create. All indications point to this being a manufacturer that makes high quality security cameras that are dependable and made to last.

title: VHS to Digital
review_text:
Finally I found a device that worked so I could plug my VHS tape player into my PC and use software to create digital files from our old tapes.

When I began this project I really didn’t think it would be near as difficult as it ended up being. I tested a couple similar devices with minimal success - I could achieve video transfer but no audio.

Even with this device I struggled and finally found the only way for audio to transfer was for me to toggle the switch on the side to 16:9 - theoretically this should have nothing to do with sound but in the 4:3 setting I have no sound transfer.

The single sheet of instructions are abysmal. Set up is relatively straightforward unless it doesn’t work. The first thing I would try is switching that toggle switch on the side.

If you are looking to transfer analog VHS tapes to digital using your PC, I recommend downloading OBS Studio (free software) via obsproject.

This device does get warm during use. Since I only used it for limited amounts of time for my specific purpose it wasn’t an issue. If this was to be used long term for connecting a game system to a TV I would question its longevity.

While this worked for my purposes it is a bit glitchy. I got it to work with time thankfully and was able to accomplish what I set out to do.

This is an ok product but not outstanding.

title: Disappointed - Completely Dead at 8 Weeks
review_text:
Initially when I received this HP MicroSD card I was impressed - speed was decent, price was great, it worked well. I formatted it in my computer, ran a few tests then installed it with a security camera.

For 3 weeks I had no issues, the card was written to and read from without issue. During week 4, I started noticing glitching. Initially I thought it could be the camera until I reviewed the recorded footage and it would freeze during playback - whether played through the camera or my computer. I reformatted and installed into the camera again.

Over the next several weeks the card became less and less reliable. It would record part of the time then freeze. Playback would freeze, play for 30 seconds then freeze again.

By week 8 this card completed froze and I could do nothing with it. It won’t format, read nor write. While the price is low on this product - you’ll get what you pay for here. Spend a little more and go with a reliable MicroSD card.

This is a perfect example of why I wait a few months of testing a product prior to writing my review. Most products will work right out of the package, but none of us like when products die immediately outside of the return window - and that’s exactly what you can expect from this card.

title: Excellent Flat Cat7 Cable
review_text:
I have used and tested more Ethernet cables than I can remember and there is no question, all Ethernet cables are not created equally. Every one of the AmazonBasics branded items I’ve tested has been excellent and this cable is no exception.

Typically any device requiring an Ethernet cable will come with one in the packaging - it will work (usually). A good comparison is those cables are much like an old car - it should get you there, whereas this cable is like a high end sports car - it will get you there lightning fast, without fail.

This Cat7 is designed to be thin, but don’t let that fool you into thinking that it lacks capacity - within the thin PVC package contains aluminum shielding and 100% bare copper wires for super fast transfer speeds. The connector bases are reinforced at each end of the wire which really help hold all of the wires in place even if you have to bend and twist it to fit it within the plug. The plugs have a protective rubber boot guard that protects the clip on the plug - this becomes very important when snaking the cable through walls and tight spaces. Prior to doing this I wrap the boot and plug with a small piece of electrical tape to make sure I don’t unintentionally snag anything.

I love the white PVC shielding on this cable - not only is it durable and will help the cable withstand damage but it can be run along a wall and then painted to match the wall color.

I used this 25 foot cable to run between my router to a unmanaged switch that branches to several IoT hubs - a primary connection where speed and a reliable relay is critical - and I’ve been nothing but impressed by this product.

You will not find a better Ethernet Cable - this is really a top of the line cable that you’ll love. This is a purchase that you’ll never regret.

title: Quality Budget Friendly Optical Zoom Blue Iris Camera
review_text:
I have been working with security camera products for over 20 years - over that time I have installed systems for businesses, corporations and individuals - from enormous multimillion dollar systems to single camera nursery monitors. I’ve consulted on large projects and written about security vulnerabilities within networks for trade publications.

This is a field I know well. Over the years the technology has improved and become less and less expensive to produce. It is now practical to install security systems that would have only previously been used in commercial settings in residential.

As with all security systems my advice is never use cloud based recording - this opens your entire network to not only the company who you are giving blanket access too but also to hackers. The same is true for WiFi. Obviously WiFi is more convenient but if your privacy is a concern this really needs to be taken into account. Hackers have become quite adept at hacking into WiFi cameras and being able to not only watch your feed but control your cameras and access your entire network. If you choose to utilize WiFi cameras take the time to understand your router and employ proper VPN protocols.

Due to my security concerns with WiFi cameras my current security system is completely run through a dedicated computer utilizing the Blue Iris software. While this may seem intimidating to some, it is well worth learning and utilizing for the huge advantages in privacy and security.

I’ve noticed many people have asked if this camera works with a Blue Iris and it does without any issue. Just update to the latest firmware. The remainder of setup within Blue Iris is straightforward. The RLC-522 supports PoE 802.3af and will work with 48V active adapters which are more expensive, but you can also rely on a PoE switch, which in my opinion is a much easier, straightforward option. Something to note, if you plan on powering via a DC cable this is not included.

The varifocal lens is a major feature that sets this camera apart from others. With an adjustable lens size of 2.8-8mm the optical zoom is excellent in comparison to digital zoom where pixels are simply enlarged. This will allow for this camera to be hung higher giving a better over view shot of an area while still being able to zoom in. The 1/2.7” CMOS image sensor is decent in low light, certainly not as good as 1/1.8” but I’ve found the low light capabilities strong in comparison to many similar cameras. The 18 IR LEDs do a decent job of illuminating objects in the fore and mid ground areas.

The camera has a built in microphone that allows for sound recording, though no speaker so two way communication will not be possible with this unit.

Unlike many similar cameras a mount is not required to be purchased separately. Mounting is fairly simple although care must be taken to mount so your lens is ultimately pointed in the direction you want as this camera does not pan nor tilt.

The varifocal zoom is not particularly fast so if you were trying to zoom in on action, such as a moving vehicle as it passed, you will likely miss it. Although if you have an area you want to focus on for a period of time it works fine.

In terms of storage, the RCL-522 utilizes H.264 rather than H.265 which will require more space to record the same data. Storage options include a MicroSD card slot with support up to 64GB - which I find lacking, cloud storage via FTP, the propriety Reolink NVR systems, or as I use set ups utilizing software such as Blue Iris.

When all things are taken into account this is a very solidly build varifocal camera, suited to outdoor environments, decent daytime / nighttime resolution, fairly easily mounted, and setup in Blue Iris was easy and straightforward. While I would prefer to have pan and tilt capabilities at this price point that is unrealistic. Overall I have been quite impressed with this camera and would recommend it for many security situations.

title: REALLY IMPRESSIVE WIRELESS WiFi CAMERA SET!
review_text:
I have been testing and reviewing WiFi cameras for the last five years. Over that time the industry has seen major advances which has led to incredible availability of high quality cameras at very reasonable costs. I have tested nearly 100 cameras and it takes a bit to impress me but I must say this set did just that.

I had no problem setting this camera up on my network. I set it both up after fully charging them in about a half hour with no issues.

Due to security precautions I never use cloud based storage in relation to WiFi cameras because that amount of constant data transfer opens your network to unnecessary hacking. The only cameras that I employ in my home allow for local storage - whether to a dedicated hard drive or individual micro SD held within each camera. This camera can hold up to a 128GB micro SD card. The card will over write the oldest data first - how much footage the card holds is dictated by the settings you select. Due to the fact these cameras only record when motion is detected a 128GB card will hold quite a lot and should suffice for 99% of people.

It’s important to know that by default the camera is set to record and save to the cloud. That can easily be reset in preference settings. In addition if you don’t install a micro SD card your camera will only capture still images when viewing - if you don’t have two extra micro SD cards order two when purchasing this set.

The camera provides a crystal clear 1080p footage and I found the motion activation very responsive. With my mesh WiFi network I encountered no lag in viewing - typically camera lag has to do with individual network properties rather than the camera itself.

The batteries in these cameras are phenomenal and actually last as long as is claimed in the listing. The battery’s life will be dictated by how often the camera is activated by motion but I have had both cameras installed and running now for over 2 months without having to recharge yet.

In my tests I found this to be an excellent budget friendly WiFi camera set that as long as you utilize the micro SD card feature is quite secure. Not having to run power cables is a major advantage and will allow these to be placed in far more places. The internal batteries are excellent and are sure to impress. The app is well designed, intuitive and easy to use even for beginners.

This is an all around excellent set of wireless WiFi cameras that I have recommended and do to you as well.

title: Decent Macro and Wide Angle Lenses - Zoom Not as Much
review_text:
The built in camera and apps on the iPhone allow for so much more creative work than most of us lovers of photography ever dreamed possible - there is no reason not to enjoy that technology. Years ago I never would have dreamed of shooting photos with my phone rather than my DSLR but that is, in fact, often the case.

This has led me to testing, evaluating and reviewing many accessories that make creative shooting with the phone even more versatile than it is natively.

I’ve reviewed a few similar lens kits. This one comes with macro, wide angle and zoom lenses, a mini tripod for the zoom lens, the adapters needed to attach the lenses to the phone and a case for it all.

The wide angle and macro lenses are both decent quality - not professional quality but adequate for hobby enthusiasts. Of the three lenses the macro is the best. The wide angle causes photos focus to get soft towards the edges.

title: DECENT WIRELESS HEADPHONE SET at a GREAT PRICE!
review_text:
I have had the opportunity to review many headsets and headphones over the years and without question the recent technological advancements have aided this area by leaps and bounds.

I can not recommend buying Bluetooth 5.0 enough over previous technologies if your devices support it. Nearly all devices that are Bluetooth 5.0 capable, including this one, will be backwards compatible with earlier technologies as well.

Battery life is outstanding with these headsets lasting a solid 6+ hours each in all of my tests. It is easily charged using the included charging case which will allow the earbuds to be recharged a few times from its one full charge. The case has a digital display that shows the percentage of battery remaining so there is no surprise when it runs out of power.

Since the earbuds can be used together for stereo sound or individually you can potentially double play time by using one at a time.

This unique charging case is powered via an included standard USB to micro USB cable.

After receiving, I made sure the case was fully charged then confirmed each earbud had a full charge. After verifying full power within each earbud I followed the simple pairing instructions and had no problems whatsoever. Once the earbuds are removed from the case they first pair with each other then you simply pair with your Bluetooth device.

These earbuds will require testing which of the 2 sizes of ear bud caps work best for the individual user. I typically use the medium size which with this set the smaller ones worked better for me. I purchase sets of replacement memory foam ear bud pads which I ended up replacing them with as they are more comfortable and simply work better.

The sound from these headphones is decent - from the deep bass notes to the vibrant midtones to the high treble. I tested these headphones with a wide range of audio - from audiobooks to jazz, heavy metal, country, classical and blues - everything sounded ok.

I have listened to both music and audiobooks through these as I moved throughout my home and it will easily pick up the signal through walls up to 40’ away, and even more without obstacles. This is really an reasonable set Bluetooth headphones.

While these are ok for listening to music, how are they for calling? The sound through these headphones is pretty good - on both ends. That is not always the case. Many of the other headphones I have tested, while they sound good to the person using it - those who they are speaking to can’t hear them clearly. It is no fun having a conversation where the other person keeps saying, “huh, what did you say?” You won’t have to worry about that with this set.

If you are looking for an decent headphone set, that is comfortable to wear, provides decent sound and reception and has the power to last many hours this is a good choice at a very reasonable price.

title: Very Limited Internal Memory - No Ability to Upgrade
review_text:
I have been working with security camera products for over 20 years - over that time I have installed systems for businesses, corporations and individuals - from enormous multimillion dollar systems to single camera nursery monitors. I’ve consulted on large projects and written about security vulnerabilities within networks for trade publications.

This is a field I know well. Over the years the technology has improved and become less and less expensive to produce. It is now practical to install security systems that would have only previously been used in commercial settings in residential.

Personally I really like the flood light security cameras. Flood lights are a natural deterrent for criminal activity - when the light comes on it startles the person trying to sneak around and having the light almost guarantees that you will receive a clear image.

I have tested and reviewed several similar floodlight camera systems. As with all security systems my advice is never use cloud based recording - this opens your entire network to not only the company who you are giving blanket access too but also to hackers. The same is true for WiFi. Obviously WiFi is more convenient but if your privacy is a concern this really needs to be taken into account. Hackers have become quite adept at hacking into WiFi cameras and being able to not only watch your feed but control your cameras and access your entire network. If you choose to utilize WiFi cameras take the time to understand your router and employ proper VPN protocols.

In terms of this particular floodlight WiFi camera by FREECAM it comes with a 16GB SD card which is sealed within and a larger SD card can not be added. Unfortunately 16GB in this application is very little and will not allow for adequate storage if review of footage is necessary. This forces the user into using the cloud service which opens the network to much greater risks.

The app, CAMB, while certainly not the worst I’ve used, is far from the best. It is not particularly user friendly and support is non existent. I was able to achieve reasonable reliability in terms of video capture although the alert system is not reliable.

The bulbs are bright - 2400 Lumen and while they are not replaceable being LED, they should last a long time.

Installation was as straightforward as installing any floodlight and required around 20 minutes.

In terms of WiFi flood light cameras, I’m disappointed with the limitation of the 16GB SD card - this tends to point to the company trying to force buyers into their cloud services. I have carefully monitored all traffic and if the camera was attempting to access the internet independently - my internet blocks will prevent this but I have not detected anything in my testing thus far.

The app is not dependable nor is it user friendly.

All around this is a product I would avoid.

title: Phenomenal Sound Quality, Easy Set Up - GREAT BUY!
review_text:
I paired this sound bar with our Sony XBR-65X850E 65” TV and it could not have been easier.

While my TV would allow me to connect to the sound bar via Bluetooth I opted to connect via the HDMI ARC connection to avoid any sound lag. In addition to these 2 connection options you can connect via optical cable.

I followed the instructions - plugged the HDMI cable (included) into the ARC HDMI port, plugged the sound bar and subwoofer into the surge protector and turned everything on. The TV automatically recognized the soundbar and changed my output.

The sound bar automatically connected to the subwoofer without me doing anything at all. I decided to move the subwoofer to another area of the room - I unplugged it, moved it, plugged it back in and it again reconnected without any problem.

I was able to pair the system with my iPhone without any issue and the sound is stunning. From the rich bass of the subwoofer, the vibrant midtones, to the crisp highs - every note is clear and distinct.

While I have a true 5.1 surround system most of the TV broadcasts are not going to utilize that type of system and the sound is actually richer through this sound bar with a subwoofer.

This soundbar can be easily wall mounted using the included template. Since I have my TV on an entertainment center base I’ve used the “AmazonBasics Universal Sound Bar TV Bracket - Adjustable Arm for Mounting Above or Under TV, Black” to mount the sound bar below the TV where it hangs perfectly level. Since this is a universal bracket it requires a bit of figuring out the best configuration but it comes with everything you’ll need and it works great.

The entire system is intuitive and user friendly. While many sound systems require hours to hook up and figure out how to use correctly this one is so straightforward. The remote doesn’t have a bunch of excess buttons that you’ll never need or use.

The new sound technologies Sony employs with this sound system are incredible. The “Immersive AE” function changes the directionality on the sound and is remarkable.

In my instance my TV remote was able to control it immediately with no issues.

I have always been impressed with the quality of Sony’s audio and video products - they are constantly innovating and improving on their products and in my experience they hold up far better than other brands.

I highly recommend this soundbar for anyone looking for an easy way to improve the quality of the sound from your TV - and you’ll be pleasantly surprised by the rich sound it will deliver regardless of what you play through it.

title: Decent BUDGET Security System - with Absolutely Atrocious Software
review_text:
I have been working with security camera products for over 20 years - over that time I have installed systems for businesses, corporations and individuals - from enormous multimillion dollar systems to single camera nursery monitors. I’ve consulted on large projects and written about security vulnerabilities within networks for trade publications.

This is a field I know well. Over the years the technology has improved and become less and less expensive to produce. It is now practical to install security systems that would have only previously been used in commercial settings in residential. Unfortunately while the hardware has improved dramatically the software often has not - which is the case with this set.

The set I got did not come with a hard drive which wasn’t a big deal as I always have a few around. A suitable SATA Hard Drive can be purchased for $25-$400 depending on size and quality.

In terms of this system it should be clear based on the price - this is a budget system. That doesn’t mean it won’t work but these cameras are not going to pan, tilt or zoom (the lens is fixed).

If these are installed with this in mind they can still be very effective they just need to be positioned correctly.

For instance if these cameras were placed up high on a second floor overhang you would see an overview of the surrounding area but would not be able to zoom in to see facial characteristics. On the other hand, if placed on a porch a bit above head height you will have no issue making out the same. Placement is key.

In terms of wiring any POE (Power Over Ethernet) camera is excellent. The cameras are powered and transmit data over the same Ethernet cable. There are several advantages to these systems the most important is security as the cameras are not broadcasting wirelessly making them more difficult to hack.

The camera operation is excellent for the price. The images are clear and crisp and night vision operates without issue.

Where this set falls apart is on the software side - unfortunately this is often the case. The software is so non user friendly that it is almost unusable. I have used countless similar systems and this has to be among the all time worst software operating systems I have ever encountered.

There are countless glitches and bizarre, nonsensical methods for how it has to be initiated that it became comical as I worked through them all. I’ve actually used it as an example with colleagues as why a system must be actually set up prior to recommending it as on its face this appears to be an excellent value but the software unfortunately ruins what otherwise would be an excellent budget system. Unfortunately one depends on the other.

Due to the horrid software this set depends upon I would not recommend it. I can only hope the manufacturer would scrap the current software completely and rebuild with modern usability standards being their primary concern.

Once you plug it into a computer it must be initialized after that it’s good to go.

I’ve used several similar devices and I’ve found they all get warm after running. They are transferring huge amounts of data very quickly. This is why the device requires a heat dissipation system. I don’t find that this unit gets any hotter than the others I have used.

Transfer speeds are excellent and I’ve had no issues with this unit. This provides an excellent way to quickly backup an entire system so you can do whatever is needed.

This is a great tool to have. I recommend this item - I just wish they would have included a manual.

title: EXCELLENT VALUE PRICED OUTDOOR WiFi CAMERA
review_text:
I have been testing and reviewing WiFi cameras for the last five years. Over that time the industry has seen major advances which has led to incredible availability of high quality cameras at very reasonable costs.

I had no problem setting this camera up on my network. I set it up vis Ethernet cable and WiFi and each time it connected without any issue.

Due to security precautions I never use cloud based storage in relation to WiFi cameras because that amount of constant data transfer opens your network to unnecessary hacking. The only cameras that I employ in my home allow for local storage - whether to a dedicated hard drive / served or individual micro SD held within each camera. This camera can hold up to a 128 Gb micro SD card. The card will over write the oldest data first - how much the card holds is dictated by the settings you select.

It’s important to know that by default the camera is set to record and save to the cloud. That can easily be reset in preference settings.

The camera provides a crystal clear 1080p image. I found little to no lag with my mesh WiFi network - typically camera lag has to do with individual network properties rather than the camera itself. As with the vast majority of outdoor cameras pan and tilt controls are not possible with this camera as it has a fixed lens.

This camera has a built in microphone and speaker allowing for 2 way communication making it ideal for placement at home entrances. In addition it has motion detection and an alarm function that can be set when you are away. If motion is detected you can have it set to alert your phone, record and / or record the action.

I found all of the controls intuitive and easy to control. The app is well designed allowing for the installation of multiple cameras and easy switching between multiple camera views.

In my tests I found this to be an excellent budget friendly WiFi camera that as long as you utilize the micro SD card feature is quite secure.

This is a camera I would recommend.

title: Small Laptop Backpack & Not Very Comfortable to Carry
review_text:
Any backpack that is intended to carry a laptop must provide adequate protection for the computer and have storage for the related accessories.

This backpack accomplished that adequately. There are several internal pockets and sleeves to hold various sized accessories and items, an external pocket for storage, an easy access location for getting to items quickly and a port for charging electronics from a battery backup.

The outer shell material is high quality and construction is well done. The material resists water and will hold up well to use.

Here is where this bag falls short. In an effort to make the backpack compact there is little storage space and it’s just not comfortable to carry on the back. The laptops padded location is directly resting on the users back - this is not unusual in backpacks of this style but with this particular bag it feels stiff and awkward. Regardless of how I’ve tried to shift and arrange items within the bag this backpack is just not comfortable in use. Had additional padding been used between the laptop and the surface that rests against the users back it would have helped as would allow for the bag to shape more to how backpacks are carried.

Once a laptop and power adapter are packed inside this backpack there is little room left for anything more than a few flat folders. This lack of capacity makes it impractical for students who must carry all they need for a day of classes.

While this backpack has several features that are not bad the disadvantages make it a product I wouldn’t recommend.

title: Great Way to Keep Cords Organized

Whether behind an entertainment center or computer station the tangle of cords running between peripheral devices can become not only a mess but also dangerous. I have used several similar cable organization products and this one not only works well but it looks great.

The only thing I prefer in other products I’ve tested over this one is having small cable entry points on the sides which allows for better separation of cables and greater ventilation. This is only really necessary if there are high voltage cables being run out of the surge protector. For most typical home uses the two openings are adequate.

I definitely recommend this product, it works well for organizing cables and looks great.

title: Reliable Set of Cables at a Great Price!
review_text:
I have had the opportunity to review more iPhone / iPad cables than I can possibly remember and over the years I have found there are certain characteristics that I look for in a cable that will increase its chances of being a high quality, long lasting cable.

I knew as soon as I saw these cables by Phantom they had those characteristics and after using it for the last 6 weeks I have been nothing but impressed.

I’ve found long, 6.6’ or 2m or longer, cables must have increased shielding in order to not lose speed in data transfer. In addition, they must employ some design element to resist kinking due to the stresses from being that length.

These cables suffer no noticeable loss in speed from their length during either charging or data transfer. The braided nylon covering is tight and resists kinking or becoming tangled. As with any braided nylon covered cable avoid them rubbing against sharp or rough surfaces for maximum life expectancy.

The primary failure point of any cable is where the cable meets the plugs. Due to the strains constantly put at those junctions this is where electrical shorts are most likely to occur and thus cause eventual failure. The ports on these cables taper and extend up towards the cable body protecting this critical juncture point greatly reducing chances of failure in these locations.

While some cables have ports that are so bulky they will not fit through case charging ports I have not found that to be the case with any I’ve tested with these cables.

This cable set is reliable, charging and data transfer speeds are great and they are designed to last. The price honestly can’t be beat for this level of quality.

I definitely recommend this set.

title: VERY COOL SECURITY LIGHT!
review_text:
I have had the opportunity to review a few similar products over the last couple years and this new security light by Sentry has some great features that make it a stand out among other security lights.

I found installation straightforward and simple. For those who have trouble connecting to your WiFi, the most common issue is the strength of the different frequencies your router is broadcasting. The easiest way to resolve this is to go into your router settings via your computer and turn off the 5 GHz band during setup. This is necessary sometimes when initially setting up SmartHome products. While some may find this necessary for this product, I did not using my Orbi router system.

The Geeni App is easy to use and makes setup and customization of how the light operates user friendly.

This unit puts out a huge amount of light - 2100 Lumens to be exact while only using 24 watts of power thanks to it utilizing the LED bulbs.

This is the first security bulb I have reviewed that actually has a built in siren. This could be an outstanding feature if needed. Whether utilized to scare off someone attempting to break in to your home or to cause unwanted pests to run the other way - it will work! This siren is effective because it’s loud.

The speaker can also be used for communication purposes. By utilizing a built in microphone you’ll be able to have conversations with those you are viewing through the camera. The speaker and microphone have a surprisingly high clarity. The only thing I found odd with this aspect of this product is this is not a light you’ll want to place at head height as the light is so bright and the camera is really made to provide a wide angle view. Therefore when you speak through the speaker I found people usually look around and can’t figure out the source of the disembodied voice.

After using this product for the last 6 weeks I have found that it performs excellently. By installing a 128GB micro SD card within it, saving videos is easy and I’ve had plenty of time to review the footage. I love that it holds the recording locally so there is no cloud subscription fee required.

This is an excellent security light that will not only light the night when motion is detected, but will record it, alert you, scare the intruder with a siren or allow you to speak to them (or apologize for just scaring them with the siren).

This is an outstanding product that I definitely recommend.

title: INCREDIBLE ETHERNET Cat8 CABLE
review_text:
I have used and tested more Ethernet cables than I can remember and there is no question, all Ethernet cables are not created equally.

Typically any device requiring an Ethernet cable will come with one in the packaging - it will work (usually). A good comparison is those cables are much like an old car - it should get you there, whereas this cable is like a high end sports car - it will get you there lightning fast, without fail.

This Cat8 is designed to be thin, but don’t let that fool you into thinking that it lacks capacity - within the thin package contains the needed shielding and wires for super fast transfer speeds. The connector bases are reinforced at each end of the wire which really help hold all of the wires in place even if you have to bend and twist it to fit it within the plug. The connector plug itself is gold plated which is the ultimate standard in connectivity.

I used this .5 meter to run between my router to my switch - a primary connection where speed and a reliable relay is critical - and I’ve been nothing but impressed by this product.

You will not find a better Ethernet Cable - this is really a top of the line cable that you’ll love. This is a purchase that you’ll never regret.

title: MINIMAL BULK allowing for INCREDIBLE PRODUCTIVITY with MAXIMUM PROTECTION!
review_text:
I have tested a few cases for my 10.5” iPad Pro and my iPro prior to that - I have found each case to have significant design flaws. Many are far too bulky which, while protecting the iPad, takes away from the inherent charm of it being a lightweight device to grab and go. Other cases I found would simply not stay attached, either the backing attached to the rear of the iPad or the keyboard cover would always be coming off. In testing this product by GreenLaw I have found that to absolutely not be the case - in fact, I have found after using the keyboard for a while it has functions that save me time far beyond just typing and protection!

As I stated, I’m using this with my A1709, 10.5” iPad Pro. It fits absolutely perfectly. While the set comes with foam feet that can be placed as bumpers if the case was a bit too loose in order to snug it tight, this was not necessary with my iPad.

I followed the directions and charged the case by plugging it in with the included micro USB cable for 4 hours prior to using it for the first time. Once it achieved charging its battery fully - the LED battery indication light changed from red to green, I unplugged the the case and moved on to pairing.

The pairing process could not have been easier. I just put my iPad in Bluetooth mode, turned the case on via the small switch on the right side of the keyboard and pressed function + delete (all instructions are well written in the manual) and it paired on the first attempt.

There are loads of helpful functions this keyboard can do once you start working on it. I tend to discover something new every few times using it even now. As is obvious by the listing, the keys can be backlit, although this will greatly diminish the battery life of the keyboard. It can be helpful in certain lighting but I typically leave it off. With the backlighting off this keyboard’s battery lasts a very long time.

Not only is the keyboard outstanding but this is an excellent case for the iPad! It doesn’t add a lot of bulk nor weight yet the hard plastic case and the rigidity of the keyboard laying over the glass of the iPad’s screen provide perfect security and protection keeping the iPad safe.

This is both an outstanding keyboard and an amazing case. I have thoroughly enjoyed mine and am sure you will as well.

title: Awesome Concept - Execution Needs Fine-Tuning
review_text:
Being both an audiophile and a lover of all new tech when I first read about this technology coming out a few years ago I started looking forward to testing it.

So what are the potential advantages of bone conduction earphones? I’m glad you asked. When properly adjusted they allow the user to enjoy listening to whatever they choose while not blocking external noises, thus allowing the user to react to ambient noises. This should make them safe to use while driving or doing other activities that require hearing ambient noise in order to conduct safely.

Unfortunately these R9 headphones allow for very little fine adjustment. In order for this type of headphones to work properly and provide the highest sound quality they should rest flat, or almost flat against the skin between the front of the ear and the rear part of the cheek bone. When adjusting the speaker it is clear when the speaker is properly adjusted. The adjustment that I was able to do came from working the rubber casing and sliding the speaker further onto the arm that wraps around the back of the head. By twisting the speaker inward I was able to get the speaker closer to the proper location but not exactly correct. Due to this, sound quality is not optimal and surrounding people are able to hear what the listener is playing.

In terms of design choices I find it odd that while it’s estimated between 70-95% of the population of any ethnicity is right handed this manufacturer chose to place the controls on the left side. This makes controlling them both awkward and difficult. While the buttons operate in a standard press and double press pattern it is awkward reaching across and doing it on the left side.

In terms of operation these headphones maintain a solid connection for the full 33 feet they are rated for and the batteries lasted approximately 6.25 hours on the first full charge cycle. Sound quality is middle of the road especially due to not allowing for fine adjusting of the speakers.

With a couple of minor changes these headphones would be a much better product. If the speakers are held in the correct positions it is much better - if an adjustment system were added these could potentially have much higher sound quality. In addition, obviously the controls should be placed on the right side for ease and regularity of access.

This is a great technology with a lot of potential. These headphones while not capable of fine adjustments would probably fit someone with an average sized head better. My head is a bit smaller than average which made these fit a bit too large for me.

title: MUCH GREATER CAPACITY THAN I  INITIALLY ANTICIPATED
review_text:
I have had the opportunity to review several products produced by WindTook and each of them have been well designed, manufactured from high grade materials with an excellent level of craftsmanship. This backpack fit that pattern in every regard.

While at first glance I didn’t think this backpack was going to be very large, once I began filling it in order to test I was amazed at all it could securely hold.

The outer shell of the backpack is constructed with 600D Polyester making it water resistant, very durable and easy to keep clean. There are dual mesh side pockets for holding a water bottle, umbrella or anything moist. Every pocket securely closes with zippers that are well made and have an 2” pull on each closure. All inner pockets are lined with a high quality polyester material. The bottom of the pack is protected by a polyvinyl covering. The right side has a built in charging USB charging port with a zippered pocket large enough to securely hold my largest power supply.

The back of the pack where the straps attach has as much padding as I’ve ever seen on similar bags - the padding measured it at approximately 1/2” thick. While this padding is thick it is designed to include ventilation so that is doesn’t cause a build up of heat while wearing. The center of the back area has an attached strap so the pack can be looped over the handle of a suitcase for ease of carrying when traveling.

The outer most pocket, on the front of the pack, measures 6” x 8”, is the perfect size for storing a wallet, keys, glasses or anything easy access is desired. The following pocket is designed for storing basic writing utensils - 3 locations for pens, a place for a calculator, a large sleeved area and a secured zippered area.

The 2 large zippered storage areas are what surprised me the most. The one at the center of the bag is padded on both sides, has dual sleeves for sliding a tablet or small computer down in either side, and the front side has a small 5” x 7” zippered pocket at the top to secure small items. This center area is deceptively large, I found I could fit far more than I anticipated as it expands allowing for additional space.

The rear most pocket is designed primarily for a laptop having additional padding on either side. I was able to slide my laptop in and out with no problem and it was secure while being carried.

I reviewed the 6351-Blue model this time. The blue material appears very similar to blue jean material in color while the inner teal provides a nice contrast. These colors are gender neutral, look nice together and should appeal to many.

This is a high quality backpack that will hold up well in use regardless of what you have in mind. It will be an excellent bag for school, overnights away or for traveling. This is a product I would recommend made by an excellent company.

title: Small, Unobtrusive, Motion Sensor
review_text:
I have been using SmartHome devices for over 10 years and have watched this category grow and change in incredible ways over that time. Many of the changes have been consumer driven while some have been manufacturer driven.

Consumers have been wanting a reliable outdoor motion sensor for a long time. The design of this motion detector is the most compact and resilient, where it can hold up under covered outdoor conditions. I have had this set up on my covered front porch for the last several weeks without any issue.

While the Amazon listing reads that it detects temperature, luminosity and motion thus far I’ve only been able to get my unit to read luminosity and motion - temperature is not showing whatsoever.

I was able to pair the unit with my SmartThings 3rd Generation Hub immediately with no problems. I opened the original app and went to add a device, as soon as I pulled the plastic battery protector the detector was recognized.

In regards to operating, other than not showing temperature, it is working flawlessly. I have used it as a trigger to turn on my front porch light from dusk till dawn. It easily detects motion from appropriately 20-25 feet away.

I read that there was a better custom handler for this device that could be added to SmartThings but I was unable to locate it. I wish the manufacturer would have either added it to SmartThings or had the handler text within the manual.

Even without the temperature capabilities this is among the best motion detectors I have used. It is a product I would recommend.

title: EXCELLENT BUDGET PRICED ROUTER
review_text:
I have worked within computer related industries my entire adult life so I have worked with more routers than I can begin to remember. Routers have changed a great deal in the last several years.

It is important to purchase a router based on what your household needs. Things to consider: are you just connecting a computer via WiFi or Ethernet cable, do you have multiple mobile devices, are you running a gaming system, are you streaming video services (like Netflix or Hulu), do you upload / download large files from the internet over WiFi, do you use SmartHome devices / hubs? Do you do more than one of these activities at a time? How large is your home?

In an effort to not make this overly confusing and router will not replace the need for paying for internet service this only broadcasts the internet you pay for throughout your home so you can access it. Many people pay their ISP (internet service provider) for high speed internet and then have a router that can not utilize the speed they pay for each month - so it is wasted and they are left wondering why the internet speeds are so slow.

Depending on your internet usage characteristics and the size of your home this router may be a perfect option. After running full diagnostics on this unit I found that it performs well, especially at this price point. This is a great router for smaller homes with one primary user who does not utilize multiple SmartHome products.

I had no issues with setup and installation. I found the iOS app worked adequately. This router does not have many of the advanced features of other routers but at around a tenth the cost that’s to be expected.

For the appropriate homes and users this is a perfect solution for an economical router.

title: INCREDIBLE SUPER LONG ETHERNET Cat8 CABLE!
review_text:
I have used and tested more Ethernet cables than I can remember and there is no question, all Ethernet cables are not created equally.

Typically any device requiring an Ethernet cable will come with one in the packaging - it will work (usually). A good comparison is those cables are much like an old car - it should get you there, whereas this cable is like a high end sports car - it will get you there lightning fast, without fail.

This Cat8 is extra thick due to the shielding within and the additional insulation. The connector bases are reinforced at each end of the wire which really help hold all of the wires in place even if you have to bend and twist it to fit it within the plug. The connector plug itself is gold plated which is the ultimate standard in connectivity.

This Cat8 Ethernet Cable is 30’ long which makes it absolutely ideal for using it to directly plug your TV or gaming system into your router. So many of us stream programs and movies via our TV and there is no comparison in speed between a WiFi connection and a wired connection. For gamers, it is absolutely the way to go - do away with all lag caused by your WiFi by connecting directly to your router.

You will not find a better 30’ Ethernet Cable - this is really a top of the line cable that you’ll love. This is a purchase that you’ll never regret.

title: SOLID MESH ROUTER with BASIC PARENTAL CONTROLS INCLUDED
review_text:
I have tested and reviewed many routers and this router by Onelink is an excellent product in many regards.

I found installation and setup straightforward and easy. Using their app you just follow the instructions - I had mine up and running within 15 minutes with no issues. Setup does require downloading and using the Onelink Connect App so if you do not use a cellphone or tablet this would be an issue.

In my tests I found excellent WiFi speeds without any dead zones throughout my 1500 square foot house and am able to pick up a solid signal well into my yard outside.

I utilize 45 SmartHome devices and 6 WiFi cameras all of which it handled without issue.

The router communicates directly with my Onelink Smoke and Carbon Dioxide detectors, and will immediately override anything I’m doing on my iPhone to alert me if there was fire or carbon dioxide detected.

The router has 3 Ethernet out ports allowing for direct connections.

The parental controls allow you to assign devices to a particular user and then set their access to the internet based on a G / PG / R type rating. While this system does not allow for as much control as Circle it is included with no additional fees and works well.

In all of my tests this router exceeded my expectations and impressed me. I definitely would recommend this product.

title: EXCELLENT SET OF WIRED HEADPHONES
review_text:
While I tend to use wireless headphones most of the time, there are times, such as when flying that I need wired headphones and these are AWESOME.

These headphones are equipped with an iPhone Lightning Connector which is the perfect size to fit through the opening in the case on my iPhone, it snaps into place without issue and provides a stable connection.

These are a great set of wired headphones that performed very well in all of my tests. This is definitely a product I would recommend.

title: EXCELLENT AFFORDABLE SURGE PROTECTOR
review_text:
It’s only smart to use a surge protector for all electronic devices. And while this unit may not protect your devices from a direct lighting strike it will definitely protect from fluctuations in current.

This 6 outlet, 2 USB surge protector is easily mountable using the 2 included screws. I simply placed the bottom on my printer / scanner and hit copy - that provides an exact mounting template. Following that, tape the piece of paper where you want to mount, pre drill small pilot holes through the paper marking where your screws go, remove paper, insert screws, mount.

The 2 USB (2.4A each) easily accommodates most USB plugs and self regulates charging speed to charge your devices at the fastest possible speed.

There are 6 surge protected, 3 prong outlets. The farthest one to the right is offset to provide room for larger brick style plugs.

I mounted mine to the underside of my laptop desk next to the couch and it has operated perfectly.

While the box shows that the power button illuminates a blue color when on, it does not. I checked with the manufacturer and that is not a defect - there is no LED light there. Not a big deal.

This would be the perfect surge protector / outlet strip for next to the bed, taking on cruises or other locations where you need extra outlets and protection from electrical fluctuations.

title: IMPRESSIVE ROOM MONITORING CAMERA LAMP
review_text:
This new video camera lamp by Panasonic is really a quality product - outstanding camera, nice lamp, and great features seen in few other systems.

Set up was very easy requiring minimal effort - I just followed the enclosed directions and what the app said and breezed through putting it together and setting it up.

The HomeHawk App is easy to use and overall quite intuitive. I’ve had no problem figuring it out as I’ve worked my way around within it. Once you get into the more complex settings it takes going to multiple areas of the app which is unnecessary.

The lamp has many settings to choose from - the preset modes are Home, Away and Basic, each with different predetermined settings or you can create your own.

The camera holds up to a 256 GB microSDXC card (Class 10, or UHS Speed Class 1 or higher) so you won’t have to worry about monthly cloud storage fees. Once the card is full it will automatically write over the oldest data. It records both audio and video data and can be set to record in a multitude of ways.

The camera records at up to 1920 x 1080 pixels, 2.0 megapixel, and 140 degrees - providing an ultra clear image of the entire room. While the lens is discreet it is visible if anyone looks at the front of the lamp. This is certainly not a hidden camera.

The lamp has three different sensors that detect presence - it detects motion, sound and temperature. In my tests I found this system to be incredibly accurate at detecting when there was a presence in the room and recording.

The base of the lamp holds eight AA batteries that act as a backup power source in the case of a power outage and will power the lamp for 1 hour.

One thing to note, while the listing says that it provides color night vision - what really happens is when the lamp detects presence it turns the lamp on in order to record in color. True night vision - in the dark - is monochrome.

While the listing states that the device or app can be connected to Dropbox for free cloud based video storage I have yet to find where it’s possible to do that and the online guides do not refer to it.

As someone who has used, reviewed and written about SmartHome products for many years I can say this is a quality product. I can see a few areas where it can be improved on. While the LED lamp provides a nice ambient light source it would be far better if colored light could be selected to match other SmartHome lighting. More shielding should be in place to prevent interference from other electronics - I assume that is the cause of the issues other reviewers have experienced. The app can use a bit of work in order to make it more straightforward in regards to the settings.

This is an extremely high quality camera system built into a nice modern lamp. It has sleek lines and will compliment most any room’s decor. The lamp provides a very pleasant ambient light while also providing video and audio surveillance and security.

This is a product that I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.

title: EXCELLENT NEW OUTDOOR CAMERA BY VIMTAG
review_text:
I have been using Vimtag cameras for over four years and absolutely LOVE them.

This new outdoor camera by Vimtag is absolutely outstanding.

Installation was as easy as all their other cameras have been. Simply follow the instructions and you won’t have any problems whatsoever. You’ll download the Vimtag app, plug the camera into your router via the included Ethernet cable, log in to your network and establish the connection. Once added into the Vimtag app it’s just a matter of mounting the camera.

This new B4 Outdoor Camera by Vimtag has several advanced features the previous Vimtag Outdoor cameras did not have - it has both a speaker and a microphone, allowing for two way communication, a super bright motion activated LED light and superior lenses allowing for crystal clear viewing and recording.

There are so many things I love about the Vimtag camera system. Firstly, each camera holds its own micro SD card so you don’t have to pay for monitoring or video storage, unless you want too. The only downside to this is if the camera was stolen you’ll lose the footage. Another option you have is to utilize Vimtag’s S1 Storage Box which will store the data from up to 6 cameras. In addition you can subscribe to cloud storage.

While other reviewers have commented on their cameras being hacked, I have never had this be an issue but I understand internet security and utilize firewalls that prevent access. While the first versions of the Vimtag cameras had vulnerabilities I have found those to be secured now.

This camera has worked flawlessly. Motion sets it to record whatever is going on or send an alert to my phone. If the motion takes place at night the bright LED Light comes on and I receive crystal clear images. The two way communication is incredibly clear on both ends.

This is another outstanding product by Vimtag that I don’t hesitate to recommend.

title: Very Cool Daypack!!!
review_text:
I have had the opportunity to test and review many different back / daypacks and have a good understanding of features and the difference between quality packs and those of lesser quality. This is a quality pack - that being said, this is more of a daypack rather than a travel or school backpack.

The outer shell is a heavy duty canvas material that is definitely made to hold up to wear and tear. I love the outer black and grey color scheme.

The outer most pocket has a zippered pocket (5” x 8”) on the very front and unbuttons at the top to access the full size front pocket (9” x 11”).

Both sides of the bag have snap closed pockets which could carry water bottles or umbrellas. In addition the right side has an exterior USB charging port.

The top of the bag has a double zipper closure that is then covered by a heavy canvas flap that snaps in place via snaps located on the front of the bag. This double sealing system is excellent for both security and waterproofing.

The interior of the primary compartment is HUGE. The lid itself has a zippered mesh pocket for storing items you may need easy access too.

When looking down into the primary compartment, on the left you’ll see the USB cable that leads to the exterior charging port on the right exterior of the bag - this is meant to be plugged into a power supply that then can be stored in the first pouch pocket on the upper interior side of this compartment. Following this pouch there are two smaller, pen sized pouches and then another larger one capable of holding a phone. Above these four pouches is a zippered pocket (7” x 9”). The bottom and rear side of this compartment are heavily padded with the rear wall having double storage specifically for a laptop and tablet. There is a Velcro closure strap that holds your electrics securely in place. The laptop storage area is 10” x 17” while the pocket on the front of that area is 8” x 9” - I was able to squeeze my 17” laptop into the laptop sleeve and Velcro it securely in place and feel like it was adequately protected.

In regards to the shoulder straps, they have a breathable material where they rest against your shoulders which help keep it cooler when carrying. The back is padded and I found the bag comfortable to carry when fully loaded. Above the shoulder straps is a vinyl covered handle that is a bit small for this size bag but is attached well.

All of the snaps, seams and zippers are attached very well - craftsmanship is superb.

While I love the exterior color scheme of this bag, in the bag I received the liner is a bright teal color - obviously this is a personal preference, but I believe it would look much more professional in a royal or navy blue.

This is a great bag for carrying as a daypack - such as to the beach or for an overnight trip. Due to it not being able to unzip and open flat for TSA screening I would not advise it for traveling and it lacks the multiple good sized pockets students require in order to keep their books, notebooks and school supplies organized and easy to find.

This is a well constructed bag that looks nice and is made to hold up. I would certainly recommend it for the purposes I mentioned.

title: Excellent Quality Tiny Ear Buds
review_text:
I’ve tested a few similar sets of ear buds with mixed results but I was really impressed with this set.

I read the instruction manual - removed the tiny stickers on each ear bud and plugged in the case. It achieved a full charge in just over an hour.

I removed the ear buds from the case, the right one first and then the left and they paired with each other immediately. I went to my Bluetooth settings in my iPhone and found Haylou-GT1_R and my phone paired with the set with no issue.

I was surprised at the sound quality these tiny ear buds deliver. They can definitely be turned up as loud as you’d want to listen. The bass, midtones and treble is on par for ear buds - even those that are much larger.

I did figure out that the initial way I had them in my ears was upside down when I went to test the calling features. The microphone needs to be pointed towards your mouth for best audio reception and sound quality improves a bit in this position.

Call quality was excellent for both hearing the other person and them hearing you.

In my testing the earbuds had no problem receiving within the 33’ stated range (actually making it to around 40’) and even received clearly through multiple walls - 2 rooms away with the doors closed and many obstacles in between.

The only issue I struggled with was tapping the ear bud to stop / start the music and answer / end calls / activate voice assistant and skip tracks. There is no button, you just tap an area of the exterior of the ear bud but you have to tap a very exact area which isn’t necessary easy to locate as it is not differentiated from the rest. It would have been helpful if the manufacturer put a different texture in that area so you could feel it with your finger to locate it.

While the manufacturers claims these last for 12 hours I found it was closer to 8 under normal use - still excellent. And the case will charge them without it having to be plugged back in which is always a nice feature.

These earbuds excelled in all of my tests showing that they are a high quality, dependable product.

This is a set I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.
